To transform Vestiges into Special ammo, [Alternate Weapon Action]  to activate Special ammo mode. [Alternate Weapon Action]  a second time to activate Heavy ammo mode.

Agile sight. Short zoom.

Snapshot sight. Short zoom.

  •  Increases handling speed

2410284311.description:
Agile sight. Short zoom.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed

2416023159.name: Offhand Strike
2416023159.description: Final blows grant additional weapon range, stability, and accuracy when firing from the hip for a short duration.

2420895100.name: Extended Mag
2420895100.description:
This weapon has a greatly increased magazine size, but reloads much slower.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

2427219599.name: Spread Shot
2427219599.description: Fires a short range spread of pellets.

2428997981.name: Permeability
2428997981.description: Using your class ability changes this weapon's damage type to match your equipped Super until you stow the weapon.

2437618208.name: Tex Balanced Stock
2437618208.description: Damaging targets while firing from the hip increases handling, reload speed, and movement speed while aiming down sights.

2440389870.name: Composite Propellant
2440389870.description: Rockets embed themselves in struck targets and periodically eject incendiary fuel that inflicts Scorch. The longer this weapon goes without firing, the more fuel the next rocket contains. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.

2450788523.name: Killing Wind
2450788523.description: Final blows grant increased mobility, weapon range, and handling for a short duration.

2451262963.name: Fragile Focus
2451262963.description: This weapon gains bonus range until your shield is destroyed. The bonus returns once your shield has regenerated to full strength.

2451540357.name: Amalgamation Rounds
2451540357.description:
Aiming down sights for a short period without firing compresses the spread into a single high-density projectile. Damaging a target with this shot marks them.

This weapon deals additional damage to marked targets. Defeating a marked target or landing a precision final blow with an Amalgamation Round grants invisibility and truesight.

2458213969.name: Multikill Clip
2458213969.description: Reloading grants increased damage based on the number of rapid final blows made beforehand.

2467967826.name: Chambered Compensator
2467967826.description:
Stable barrel attachment.
  •  Increases stability
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

2473404935.name: Mad Scientist
2473404935.description: This weapon fires a volley of rockets and grants Bolt Charge to all nearby allies for every other rocket that it fires.

2482418662.name: Longest Winter
2482418662.description: Periodically generates Ionic Traces while in its high-damage state.

2489430594.name: Indomitability
2489430594.description: Final blows grant grenade energy when playing a Light subclass or melee energy when playing a Darkness subclass.

2491817779.name: Prototype Trueseeker
2491817779.description: This weapon's rockets have tracking. Lock onto targets when aiming down sights. Landing hits with a full magazine grants ammo and boosts the next magazine with increased tracking strength, stability, fire rate, and cluster bombs.

2496039278.name: Bullwhacker
2496039278.description: Aim down sights for a period of time to overcharge the next bolt fired. Increases damage and area of effect for each charge level.

2509860981.name: Nadir Focus
2509860981.description: Sustained fire increases accuracy and range. Increases lunge distance for Swords, and projectile velocity for Launchers.

2516532331.name: Arc Conductor
2516532331.description: When taking Arc Damage, this weapon becomes more powerful and resists incoming Arc Damage. Kills extend the time in this overcharged state.

2518716062.name: Aggressive Frame
2518716062.description: High damage, moderate charge time. Fires a horizontal volley.

2540536653.name: Ravenous Beast
2540536653.description:
This weapon stores power when dealing or receiving damage; defeating combatants or dealing damage to Scorched combatants grants increased progress.
[Alternate Weapon Action]  : Unleashes the beast when full, increasing outgoing damage and reducing incoming Solar damage.

2551157718.name: Box Breathing
2551157718.description: Aiming this weapon for a short period without firing grants bonus range and precision damage that resets after firing or exiting zoom.

2564164194.name: Compounding Force
2564164194.description: Fires slugs that cause massive damage to combatant shields. Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.

2565067140.name: Head Rush
2565067140.description: Sliding or standing up after crouching for a short time grants this weapon a brief period of bonus handling, reload speed, and damage against Hive combatants.

2565885237.name: Nightsworn Sight
2565885237.description:
Dealing final blows to targets grants Nightsworn Sight. 

During that time, final blows grant Truesight, reload speed and precision damage is increased, and submunitions weaken targets.

2571259936.name: Compressed Wave Frame
2571259936.description: Projectiles release a wave of compressed energy when they contact the ground.

2575933030.name: Atomizing Rounds
2575933030.description: Rounds fired embed themselves in targets. [Alternate Weapon Action]  to detonate embedded rounds.

2579169598.name: Lone Wolf
2579169598.description: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

2585427437.name: Traitor's Vessel
2585427437.description:
Fires a wide horizontal spread when shot from the hip.
Final blows with this weapon have a chance to generate Ionic Traces. Powerful foes and opposing Guardians always generate Ionic Traces.

2586829431.name: Shot Swap
2586829431.description: Final blows build and store charges which allow you to swap and stow this weapon at a faster rate.

2588739578.name: Crucible Legacy
2588739578.description: Apply this shader to change the color of your gear.

2589407652.name: Timelost Magazine
2589407652.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus Super energy. When your Super expires, this weapon's magazine size is doubled for a long duration and reloads from reserves.

2590710093.name: Tireless Blade
2590710093.description: Sword ammo granted for every other powered sword kill.

2594592626.name: Controlled Burst
2594592626.description: Landing every shot in a burst grants this weapon increased damage and reduced charge time for a short duration.

2597494435.name: Frame of Reference
2597494435.description: Final blows with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage, reload speed, and range. This effect is frozen in time while the weapon is stowed.

2607392828.name: Heart Piercer
2607392828.description: Rounds from this weapon shatter into submunitions on impact. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.

2608508147.name: Heavy Slug Thrower
2608508147.description: [Aim Down Sights]  : Spins up this weapon. This weapon can be fired only when fully spun up.

2610012052.name: Golden Tricorn
2610012052.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

2620589274.name: The Fundamentals
2620589274.description: [Alternate Weapon Action]  : Changes this weapon's damage type, cycling between Void, Arc, and Solar. Grants this weapon temporarily increased damage when you apply or gain an elemental buff or debuff that matches this weapon's damage type.

2621346526.name: Ensemble
2621346526.description: Improved handling and reload speed when allies are nearby.

2622129339.name: Support Frame

This weapon can fire longer distances.

2638039968.name: Masterworked: Impact

Maximized stats.

2641107734.name: Unrepentant
2641107734.description: Reloading after defeating a target causes the next burst to be a longer, more powerful superburst.

2652708987.name: Successful Warm-Up

2656694271.name: Swooping Talons

2680121939.name: Enhanced Battery

Strong battery life.

2713678205.name: Low-Impedance Windings
2713678205.description:
Improved output efficiency.
  •  Increases shield duration
  •  Slightly increases reload speed
  •  Decreases range

2720533289.name: Magnificent Howl
2720533289.description: The number of precision final blows before reloading affects the total rounds granted with increased range and damage. Precision final blows with Magnificent Howl active extend the effect for additional rounds.

2724693746.name: Touch of Malice
2724693746.description: The final round in the magazine deals bonus damage, drawing from the wielder's life force, and then regenerates itself. Defeating powerful combatants or multiple targets rapidly restores health.

2726471870.name: Thresh
2726471870.description: Killing combatants with this weapon generates a small amount of Super energy.

2727957645.name: High Octane
2727957645.description: Igniting nearby targets partially replenishes fuel. This weapon refills itself from reserves upon gaining maximum fuel.

2732952950.name: Balanced Heat Weapon
2732952950.description: Very low heat generated. [Reload]  to vent heat from the weapon. Overheating forces a sustained vent. Manually venting at very high heat greatly increases venting speed.

2733244971.name: Trinary Vision
2733244971.description: One-shot handheld Grenade Launcher. Projectiles release a fan of three energy waves on contact with the ground.

2741975068.name: Slug Rifle

2749775325.name: Light Battery
2749775325.description:
Lightweight, agile battery.
  •  Increases handling speed
  •  Increases reload speed

2751656639.name: M1R Distribution Matrix

2757685314.name: Aggressive Frame

2767894946.name: Paracausal Beam

Excellent snapback.

2822142346.name: High-Velocity Rounds

This weapon's projectiles are particularly light and quick.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Increases reload speed

2848615171.name: Dragonfly

2888557110.name: Full Court

2896038713.name: Focused Fury

2897898513.name: Veteran's Wisdom
2897898513.description: Rapid or precision final blows release a Kinetic shockwave that exhausts targets.

2909403175.name: Mortal Polarity
2909403175.description: Precision final blows generate a lightning bolt at the target's location and grant a moderate amount of Bolt Charge.

2909846572.name: Empty Memento Socket

No memento currently selected.

2963428707.name: Transcendent Duelist

2965975126.name: Screaming Swarm

2976676960.name: Command Frame

2977709078.name: Excavation

2978966579.name: Chill Clip

2984682260.name: Full Stop

2985827016.name: Alloy Casing

Reduces weight for faster reloads.

  •  Decreases stability

2988596335.name: Alacrity

3016987351.name: Counterattack

3017780555.name: Heal Clip

3018257738.name: Carrion Munitions
3018257738.description: Final blows on tougher combatants create insectoid robots that chase combatants and explode.

3024740338.name: Edge of Intent

3032599245.name: Disorienting Grenades

Detonation has a brief disorienting effect.

3047969693.name: Desperado
3047969693.description: Reloading after a precision final blow or after rapidly defeating targets increases your rate of fire.

3063320916.name: Primeval's Torment

3108830275.name: Unrelenting

3117514172.name: Stormbringer

3124871000.name: Outlaw

3129239575.name: Featherweight

3142289711.name: Accurized Rounds

This weapon can fire longer distances.

3151536500.name: SPO-28 Front

SUROS holo sights. Medium zoom.

3164944314.name: Ager's Call
3164944314.description: Final blows with this weapon generate a slowing burst around the defeated target.

3177308360.name: Steady Rounds

3208839961.name: Four-Headed Dog

3230963543.name: Flared Magwell
3230963543.description:
Optimized for fast reloading.

3242533954.name: Parasitism
3242533954.description: This weapon does more damage to enemies based on the number of SIVA nanites that attach to them.

3275789089.name: Shield Disorient
3275789089.description: Energy matched shield explosion disorients nearby combatants.

3298446480.name: Causality Arrows
3298446480.description:
•  Arrows fired while aiming down sights cause Sacred Flames to instantly detonate.

 •  Precision hits with perfectly drawn arrows increase the power of this detonation.

3301904089.name: Spike Grenades

  •  Increases stability

3311977193.name: Helical Fletching

Aerodynamic and light.

  •  Slightly increases stability

3326204863.name: Smooth Grip

3365897133.name: Explosive Head

3371775011.name: High Tension String
